async def save(x):
    pass


# CASE fstring_nested_quotes expect=fire
async def p1(items, session, base):
    for item in items:
        async with session.get(f"{base}/{item['id']}") as resp:
            await save(resp)


# CASE backslash_continuation expect=fire
async def p2(items, session):
    for item in items:
        async with session.get(item) as a, session.get(item) as b:
            pass


# CASE hash_in_string expect=fire
async def p3(items, session):
    for item in items:
        async with session.get("https://x.test/#" + item) as resp:
            pass


# CASE triple_string_arg expect=fire
async def p4(items, db):
    for item in items:
        async with db.execute(
            """
            SELECT 1 -- it's fine
        """,
            item,
        ) as cur:
            pass


# CASE single_quote_apostrophe_string expect=fire
async def p5(items, session):
    for item in items:
        async with session.post(item, data="it's") as resp:
            pass
